name: Kirikaze Tomoe
source:
A girl in the same class as the main character. She is the type of girl who doesn't talk much and is always perceived as demure, according to Miku.

She acts suspiciously when the main character talks to her. She seems to be the type of person who can be very passionate towards something, and when you think about it, she can get a little out of control.

The question is. what's she is into now?

[From [url=https://palette.clearrave.co.jp/product/kimikoi/chara.htm]official site[/url]]
